slides.alt: A hand holding a jar of mild organic coconut fat in front of cake ingredients, with the text: I found this amazing coconut fat at the grocery store.
Cake ingredients on a wooden counter: flour, eggs, a bowl of grated coconut and a halved pumpkin, with the text: And my first thought was: I'm going to make a coconut cake.
A jar of coconut fat and a glass with a spoonful of it, next to a bar of dark chocolate, with the text: It smelled heavenly and it was softer than butter.
A baked round cake topped with toasted coconut flakes on a wooden counter, with the text: I added dark chocolate, bananas and Hokkaido, since I had them on hand. I refrained from adding sugar.
A baked cake in a springform tin covered in toasted coconut, seen from above, with the text: The toasted coconut flakes on top were a delight.
